fullDescription: Acid-maximalist startup website: near-black ink base with electric acid-lime (#d4ff00) and hot-pink (#ff2d78) accents, oversized Archivo Black display headlines (some outline/stroke), a sticky blurred nav, floating color-block blobs, an infinite scrolling marquee strip, a bento color-tile library grid, a loud hot-pink feature + stats band, and a giant CTA.
prompt:
## Resumo
A loud, acid-maximalist startup landing page. Near-black ink (#0a0a0a) canvas with electric acid-lime (#d4ff00) and hot-pink (#ff2d78) accents on a warm bone (#f4f1ea) text base. Oversized Archivo Black display headlines run up to ~150px with negative tracking and 0.88 line-height; one word uses a transparent acid text-stroke outline. A sticky blurred nav, a hero packed with floating rounded color-block 'blobs' (each with a hard 10px offset shadow) over a dot-grain texture, an infinite scrolling acid marquee strip, a 6-col bento library grid of color tiles, a full-bleed hot-pink feature section with 3 dark cards + a 4-up stat band, a giant centered CTA, and a dark footer.

## Estilo Visual
Design in a loud acid-maximalist / neo-brutalist style. Palette: ink #0a0a0a background, bone #f4f1ea text, acid-lime #d4ff00 primary accent, hot-pink #ff2d78 secondary accent. Use white/bone opacity tints (bone/15, bone/30, bone/55, bone/60, bone/70, bone/75) for borders and secondary text. Headings use 'Archivo Black' (display: letter-spacing -0.03em, line-height 0.88) at huge sizes up to clamp ~52px mobile to ~150px desktop; render selected words as transparent fill with a 3px text-stroke in acid (#d4ff00) or bone using -webkit-text-stroke + paint-order:stroke fill. UI labels/nav use Archivo (weights 400-900), body copy uses 'Space Grotesk'. Buttons are fully-rounded pills; the primary is bg-acid / text-ink and flips to bg-hot / text-bone on hover (with a subtle -translate-y-1 lift on big CTAs); ghost buttons are 2px bone/30 outlined and turn acid on hover. Eyebrow labels are uppercase, bold, wide tracking (~0.18-0.22em). Signature visual devices: a faint radial-dot 'grain' texture (rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px dots on a 4px grid) behind hero/CTA; rounded color-block tiles and floating blobs (squares, circles, rounded rects, some rotated) each with a HARD offset shadow box-shadow:10px 10px 0 #0a0a0a; a 2px border accent system; and ::selection set to acid background / ink text. Keep it confident, high-energy and playful, never muted, pastel or corporate-safe.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header (z-50, h-72px) with translucent ink background (bg-ink/90) + backdrop blur and a 2px bone/15 bottom border. Inside a max-w-[1240px] row: left = the 'VOLTPRESS' wordmark in Archivo Black (the 'PRESS' half in acid) plus a pill badge '2px bone/30 rounded-full' with a lightning icon and '1,400+ prompts' (hidden below sm); center = horizontal nav links (Library, Features, Showcase, Pricing) in semibold bone/75 that turn acid on hover, hidden below lg; right = a ghost 'Log in' text link (hidden on smallest) and a primary acid pill CTA 'Start designing' with an arrow-up-right icon that flips to bg-hot/text-bone on hover.

### Hero
A centered hero on the dot-grain texture with ~7 floating color blobs absolutely positioned around the edges (hot-pink rotated rounded-rect, acid circle, acid rotated square, bone circle, etc.), each carrying the hard 10px offset ink shadow and progressively hidden on smaller breakpoints. Centered content: a 2px acid/60 outlined pill eyebrow with a pulsing acid dot and uppercase wide-tracked 'STARTUP WEBSITE DESIGN, ON TAP'; then a massive Archivo Black headline (clamp ~52px -> 150px) reading 'LAUNCH LOUD. / SHIP FAST.' where 'LOUD.' is hot-pink, 'SHIP' is rendered as transparent text with a 3px acid stroke, and 'FAST.' is solid acid; a Space Grotesk sub-paragraph in bone/70 (max-w ~640px); two CTAs (solid acid 'Generate my site' with lightning icon + lift on hover, ghost outlined 'Browse the library'); and a small social-proof line with a users icon: 'Trusted by 12,000+ founders & indie hackers'.

### Marquee strip
A full-bleed horizontal acid (#d4ff00) strip with 2px ink top+bottom borders, ~3.5 padding, overflow hidden. An infinite-scrolling marquee track (CSS @keyframes translateX 0 -> -50%, ~22s linear infinite) duplicated twice for seamless loop, listing startup page types in Archivo Black uppercase ink text ('SaaS Landing', 'Waitlist Page', 'Pricing Grid', 'Founder Bio', 'Changelog') separated by bold asterisk icons.

### Bento library grid
A 'tiles' section in the max-w-[1240px] container. Header row (flex, md:items-end): a big Archivo Black heading 'A LIBRARY THAT HITS DIFFERENT' (HITS in hot-pink) and a short Space Grotesk bone/60 intro. Below, a 6-col bento grid (collapses to 1 col on mobile) of rounded-[2rem] color tiles with mixed spans: a large acid tile (col-span-4, ink text, 'BOLD HERO BLOCKS', a faint ink/10 corner circle + rocket icon, hard offset shadow); a hot-pink tile (col-span-2, bone text, 'PRICING GRIDS' with an inset ink chip caption); an outlined tile (2px bone/25, hover:border-acid, 'WAITLIST & LAUNCH' with an acid hourglass icon); a bone tile (ink text, 'FOUNDER & ABOUT', hot id-card icon); and an ink tile with a 2px acid border ('CHANGELOG & DOCS' in acid). Each filled tile uses the hard 10px ink offset shadow; headings are Archivo Black.

### Loud feature section
A full-bleed hot-pink (#ff2d78) section with bone text and a decorative 2px bone/30 outline circle top-right. Inside max-w-[1240px]: an ink pill eyebrow with acid text + lightning icon ('Why founders pick VoltPress'); a huge Archivo Black heading 'DESIGN SUPERPOWERS, ZERO DESIGNERS.' where 'SUPERPOWERS' is transparent with a 3px bone text-stroke. Then a 3-up grid of dark ink rounded-[1.75rem] feature cards (Prompt to page / Infinite canvas / Export clean code), each with a rounded acid icon tile (magic-wand / infinity / code icon), an Archivo-Black title, and Space Grotesk bone/60 body. Directly below, a 4-up stat band of dark ink rounded-[1.5rem] cards (2 cols on mobile) with giant acid Archivo Black numbers (1.4K / 12K / 40s / 0) and uppercase wide-tracked bone/70 labels (Prompts / Founders / To first draft / Blank pages).

### Energetic CTA
A giant centered call-to-action on the dot-grain texture, with a large acid circle blob bleeding off the left edge and a rotated hot-pink rounded-square off the right (both with the hard offset shadow, hidden on mobile). A massive Archivo Black headline (clamp ~52px -> 104px, 0.9 leading) 'YOUR STARTUP / DESERVES BETTER / THAN A TEMPLATE.' with 'DESERVES BETTER' in acid; a Space Grotesk bone/65 sub-line ('Ship a site that looks like you raised a round, in an afternoon. Start free, no card.'); then two CTAs: a solid acid pill 'Start designing free' (arrow icon, lift + flip-to-hot on hover) and a ghost outlined pill 'Watch a 60s build' with a play-circle icon.

### Footer
A dark ink footer with a 2px bone/15 top border. max-w-[1240px]: left brand block = the 'VOLTPRESS' Archivo Black wordmark (PRESS in acid), a short Space Grotesk bone/50 tagline, and three circular 2px bone/20 social icon buttons (X / GitHub / Discord) that fill acid/ink on hover. To the right, three link columns (Product / Resources / Company) with uppercase wide-tracked bone headings and Space Grotesk bone/55 links hovering to acid. A 2px bone/10 top-bordered bottom bar splits a copyright line ('© 2026 VoltPress Labs. Built loud.') from a 'Made for founders who ship.' line.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Floating geometric color blobs: ~7 absolutely-positioned shapes (rotated rounded rects, circles, rounded squares) in acid/hot/bone scattered around the hero + CTA, each with a HARD 10px 10px 0 ink offset shadow, progressively hidden per breakpoint (hidden / md:block / lg:block)

### Componente
Outline/stroke display type: selected headline words rendered as transparent fill with a 3px -webkit-text-stroke in acid or bone (paint-order: stroke fill) for the SHIP and SUPERPOWERS words

### Componente
Infinite marquee strip: a duplicated flex track animated via @keyframes marquee translateX(0) -> translateX(-50%) over ~22s linear infinite on the full-bleed acid band

### Componente
Bento color-tile grid: a 6-col grid of rounded-[2rem] tiles with mixed col-spans (4/2/2/2/2) in acid / hot / bone / outlined / ink-with-acid-border variants

### Componente
Hard offset block shadows: a reusable tile-shadow = box-shadow:10px 10px 0 #0a0a0a applied to filled tiles and blobs (neo-brutalist look)

### Componente
Radial-dot 'grain' texture: background-image radial-gradient rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px dots on a 4px grid layered behind the hero and CTA sections

### Componente
Custom ::selection styled to acid (#d4ff00) background with ink (#0a0a0a) text

### Componente
Pill buttons in three variants: solid acid (flips to hot on hover, big CTAs add -translate-y-1 lift), ghost 2px bone/30 outline (turns acid on hover), and a solid-ink chip caption

### Componente
Phosphor (Iconify ph:*) icons throughout: lightning-fill, arrow-up-right-bold, asterisk-bold, rocket-launch-fill, squares-four-fill, hourglass-high-fill, identification-card-fill, list-checks-fill, magic-wand-fill, infinity-bold, code-fill, users-three-fill, play-circle-fill, x-logo / github-logo / discord-logo

### Componente
Uppercase wide-tracked (~0.18-0.22em) bold eyebrow pill labels above hero and feature sections

## Notas Especiais
Fonts loaded from Google Fonts: 'Archivo Black' and Archivo (weights 400-900) for display + UI, and 'Space Grotesk' (400-700) for body. Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme (colors ink #0a0a0a, acid #d4ff00, hot #ff2d78, bone #f4f1ea; fontFamily black/grotesk/space; an extra xs:420px screen) plus a small <style> block for the .display class, .stroke-acid / .stroke-bone text-stroke helpers, the .marquee-track animation, the .grain dot texture, the .tile-shadow hard offset shadow, and the ::selection rule. Iconify icons via the iconify-icon web component (ph:* Phosphor set). body has overflow-x-hidden and html scroll-behavior:smooth so the floating blobs never cause horizontal scroll. Keep the energy loud and maximalist: do NOT mute the palette, soften the type, or drop the hard offset shadows.
